summary: Plus Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement with Canaccord Genuity LLC for an at-the-market offering of up to $17,350,000 of common stock. Sales may occur on the Nasdaq Capital Market under Rule 415(a)(4), with the Agent receiving a 3% commission plus $75,000 in expense reimbursement. The company may suspend or terminate sales at any time. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a transformative special situation. No special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring—is present.
